data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1969 experienced a gross prior year strengthening of $26.8 million in 2021. This was primarily driven by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years, particularly in the Non-Marine Liability class for the 2018 year of account, which saw further adverse loss experience in Construction and Binders sub-classes due to individual large losses and social inflation. Additionally, the 2020 year of account was impacted by significant natural catastrophe events and COVID-19 losses, with the 2021 Texas Winter Storm also affecting the 2020 year of account's property classes.
